name: newspaper
tip: Keep dry; bundle with other paper.

name: cardboard box
tip: Flatten boxes before binning.

name: office paper
tip: Staples are fine; remove plastic covers.

name: magazine
tip: Glossy paper is recyclable.

name: paper cup
tip: Plastic lining makes most cups non-recyclable.

name: pizza box
tip: Grease-soaked cardboard contaminates recycling.

name: tissue paper
tip: Used tissues are too short-fibred to recycle.

name: plastic bottle
tip: Empty, rinse and crush; keep the cap on.

name: milk jug
tip: Rinse; HDPE is widely recycled.

name: plastic bag
tip: Take to a store drop-off, not the kerbside bin.

name: food container
tip: Rinse off food residue first.

name: styrofoam
tip: Expanded polystyrene is rarely accepted.

name: chip packet
tip: Multi-layer foil film is not recyclable.

name: straw
tip: Too small to sort; use a reusable one.

name: glass bottle
tip: Rinse; remove metal lids and recycle separately.

name: glass jar
tip: Rinse; labels can stay on.

name: broken glass
tip: Wrap in newspaper, label as sharp.

name: window glass
tip: Different melting point from bottle glass.

name: aluminium can
tip: Rinse and crush.

name: tin can
tip: Rinse; labels can stay on.

name: aluminium foil
tip: Ball up clean foil; greasy foil goes to landfill.

name: bottle cap
tip: Metal caps: collect in a tin and recycle.

name: scrap metal
tip: Take to a scrap collector.

name: food scraps
tip: Compost; avoid meat and dairy in home bins.

name: fruit peel
tip: Great for compost.

name: tea bag
tip: Compost if the bag is plant-based.

name: coffee grounds
tip: Excellent compost nitrogen source.

name: garden waste
tip: Leaves and cuttings: compost or green bin.

name: eggshell
tip: Crush and compost.

name: battery
tip: Never bin; use a battery drop-off point.

name: paint can
tip: Take to a hazardous waste facility.

name: light bulb
tip: CFL/LED bulbs go to special collection.

name: medicine
tip: Return expired medicine to a pharmacy.

name: aerosol can
tip: Only empty cans can be recycled as metal.

name: mobile phone
tip: Donate, or use an e-waste take-back.

name: laptop
tip: Wipe data; use a certified recycler.

name: charger cable
tip: Collect with other e-waste.

name: headphones
tip: Repair, or recycle as e-waste.

name: printer cartridge
tip: Manufacturer take-back programs exist.

name: old clothes
tip: Donate if wearable; otherwise textile drop-off.

name: cigarette butt
tip: Fully extinguish; never litter.

name: diaper
tip: Wrap and bin as general waste.

name: ceramic mug
tip: Ceramics cannot be recycled with glass.

name: face mask
tip: Cut the ear loops, then bin.
